title: Altenberger Straße, Aachen
description:
Enjoy an all-Inclusive, fully furnished apartment with 3 rooms. Designed for optimal comfort and privacy, with access to community spaces and nearby nature. 

What does All-inclusive mean?: 
- Utilities
- Electricity
- Super fast WiFi
- Furniture 
- Access to community spaces
- Community events on site (Fitness, Food etc.) 
- Mobile app to manage everything all in one place
- Discounts to local shops
- Anmeldung possible

Yes, this is all included in the price. The goal is to live as a community!

Bedrooms:
- Master bedroom with a king-sized bed (160x200) 
- Second bedroom with a queen-sized bed (140x200)
- Additional room that can be converted into a bedroom, office etc.
- Plenty of storage 
- View of the calming forest 

Living Space:
- Comfortable living area with couch, dining table and chairs 
- Furnished balcony 
- Kitchen with high-spec appliances including dishwasher, stove, oven, exhaust fan and fridge
- Bathroom with shower, sink and storage
- Extra storage in the hallway

Community Spaces:
- Bar area
- Spacious lounge and chill zone
- Terrace
- Library with a vintage piano
- Coworking spaces with phone booths
- Meeting & Workshop room
- Dining room 
- Lockers
- Laundry Room

Main Terms:
- Flexible unlimited contract with a minimum length of 6 months 
- One time reservation fee (deducted from the first month’s rent) 

Additional Fees:
Pets: If you want to bring your pet friend with you, there is a 50€ monthly charge


Around You:
Live surrounded by nature and fun outdoor activities, with a bus stop just 3 minutes away for easy city access. Enjoy forest trails, a ropes course, and more just a quick walk from home.

Bus station: Aachen Preuswald (3 min walk)
Train: Aachen Central Station (20 min by bus)
ALDI Discount (15 min walk)
Kletterwald Aachen (15 min walk)
Biking trails through the forest (0 min walk)
Sportplatz (for an outdoor workout) (5 min walk)

Photo credits: HEJM Photo, POHA House
